svg.question: Is CrushSVG free to use?
svg.answer: Yes, CrushSVG is free. You can convert SVG files to PNG without installing any software or entering a credit card.

svg.question: Does CrushSVG support transparent PNG backgrounds?
svg.answer: Yes! Transparent background is supported by default. You can also pick solid white, black, or any custom color.

svg.question: How high can I scale my SVG output?
svg.answer: You can scale up to 16x or specify custom dimensions up to 4000 pixels for ultra-high-resolution, print-ready graphics.

svg.question: Are my files kept private?
svg.answer: Yes. Conversions are processed securely in your browser and on secure servers. Your files are never stored or shared.

svg.question: Can I convert complex SVGs with embedded fonts or gradients?
svg.answer: Yes, CrushSVG supports linear/radial gradients, clipping paths, embedded styles, and nested SVG groupings.

bg.question: What image formats are supported?
bg.answer: You can upload PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WebP images. The output is always a transparent PNG.

bg.question: Is my image data kept private?
bg.answer: Absolutely. Your images are processed securely and we never store, share, or use your uploaded files for anything else.

bg.question: Do I need to install any software?
bg.answer: No, CrushSVG is entirely web-based. You can remove backgrounds directly in your browser without any plugins.

bg.question: Is CrushSVG free to use?
bg.answer: Yes! You can remove backgrounds for free. Creating an account unlocks unlimited processing without any hidden fees.

bg.question: What types of images work best?
bg.answer: Product photos, headshots, social media images, and design assets with clear foreground subjects work best. Complex scenes with similar foreground/background colors may need manual touch-up.

bg.question: What is the maximum image size?
bg.answer: You can upload images up to 10MB in size. For best results, use images with a clear subject and reasonable resolution.

resizer.question: What image formats can I resize?
resizer.answer: You can upload and resize PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WebP images. You can also export to any of these formats regardless of the input format.

resizer.question: Is my image data kept private?
resizer.answer: Absolutely. All resizing happens in your browser using Canvas. Your images are never uploaded to our servers.

resizer.question: What is the maximum image size I can resize?
resizer.answer: You can upload images up to 10MB in size. Maximum output dimensions are 10,000 pixels on any side.

resizer.question: Can I maintain the aspect ratio while resizing?
resizer.answer: Yes! The aspect ratio lock is enabled by default. When you change the width, the height adjusts automatically to prevent distortion, and vice versa.

resizer.question: When should I use JPG vs PNG vs WebP?
resizer.answer: Use PNG for images requiring transparency. Use JPG for photos where smaller file size matters more than perfect quality. Use WebP for the best compression-to-quality ratio.

resizer.question: Is CrushSVG free to use?
resizer.answer: Yes! You can resize images for free. Creating an account unlocks unlimited conversions without any hidden fees.

raster.question: Can I control the quality of the vectorized SVG?
raster.answer: Yes! You can adjust presets (Low, Medium, High), color quantization, background handling, and path smoothing.

raster.question: Are my uploaded PNG and JPG images secure?
raster.answer: Absolutely. Your images are processed securely and we never store, share, or use your uploaded files for anything else.

raster.question: Does this tool support removing backgrounds?
raster.answer: Yes, you can enable the 'Ignore Background' feature to automatically remove solid backgrounds during vectorization.

raster.question: Do I need to install any software?
raster.answer: No, CrushSVG is entirely web-based. You can vectorize images directly in your browser without any plugins.

raster.question: Is CrushSVG free to use?
raster.answer: Yes! You can vectorize images for free. Creating an account unlocks unlimited conversions without any hidden fees.

raster.question: What image formats can I vectorize?
raster.answer: You can upload PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WebP images to convert them into crisp, scalable SVG vectors.
